repositories.name: vmodel-contracts
integrations: GitHub package pin consumed by every Python service repo
immutable_decisions: Only vmodel-contracts models cross repository boundaries
Payloads carry contract_version
Contract releases are SemVer-tagged before consumer pins move

repositories.name: vmodel-spec-app
persistence: batch queue and run files on local filesystem
immutable_decisions: Founder batch entry point preserves queued/running work
Scripts work when launched from macOS default shells

repositories.name: interview-engine
immutable_decisions: Founder deferrals are terminal for that sub-topic
Coverage uses provider-enforced structured output
Completed stages resume without being regenerated

repositories.name: spec-generator
immutable_decisions: Code owns IDs, ordering, stable containers and trace links
Model owns substantive prose
Stage experiments write a new directory and never mutate their source

repositories.name: verification-loop
existing_contracts: Consumes SpecBundle, AcceptanceTest set and build artifact reference
persistence: JSON reports and runner result files
immutable_decisions: Tests execute in the founder environment
LLM judges only semantic residue after deterministic checks

repositories.name: delivery-api
existing_contracts: Consumes and serves versioned pipeline payloads through delivery contracts
immutable_decisions: Generation and verification are background jobs
Per-run and global budget hard stops
Personal links instead of user accounts for the demo
Six separate repositories: vmodel-contracts, vmodel-spec-app, interview-engine, spec-generator, verification-loop, delivery-api
Modules never import each other; they exchange only versioned vmodel-contracts payloads
Local development is Ollama-first and long runs are resumable
Architecture must preserve existing repositories and technologies unless a migration ADR provides evidence and affected repositories
